title: Unresolved questions in pediatric dengue: from disease mechanisms to prevention
abstract: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Despite recent advances in understanding dengue infection, substantial gaps remain in its epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, and prevention, including vaccine development and its long-term impact. This review summarizes recent findings and highlights the most pressing research needs to advance the field and reduce individual and public health burden. RECENT FINDINGS: Dengue burden has increased, particularly among children and adolescents, and it has expanded into previously unaffected regions. Still, current data likely underestimates the true burden due to suboptimal surveillance systems. Improving control will require a better understanding of severe dengue pathogenesis, where key gaps remain, alongside reassessment of diagnostic limitations in the context of increasing vaccine availability. Vaccines represent an important complementary tool, with several candidates under study and two currently in use, each with distinct strengths, limitations, and unresolved questions. SUMMARY: More extensive research and investment are needed to address the growing burden of dengue, including severe outbreaks and geographic spread. Meanwhile, stronger regulatory engagement in the development and evaluation of innovative therapeutic and preventive measures is essential, particularly in low-income and middle-income regions that bear the highest burden. Clear communication and education on dengue, its impact, and available preventive measures proven to be well tolerated and effective are also critical to strengthen trust, improve uptake, and maximize public health impact.

abstract_zh: 综述目的:尽管最近在了解登革热感染方面取得了进展,但在其 流行病学、发病机制、诊断 和预防(包括 疫苗 的发展及其长期影响)方面仍存在巨大差距。这篇综述总结了最近的研究结果,并强调了推进该领域并减轻个人和公共卫生负担的最紧迫的研究需求。最新发现:登革热负担有所增加,特别是在儿童和青少年中,并且已扩展到以前未受影响的地区。尽管如此,由于 监测 系统不理想,当前数据可能低估了真正的负担。改善控制需要更好地了解 重症登革热 发病机制,其中仍然存在关键差距,同时在增加 疫苗 可用性的背景下重新评估诊断限制。疫苗 是一个重要的补充工具,有几个候选工具正在研究中,两个正在使用中,每个工具都有独特的优势、局限性和未解决的问题。摘要:需要更广泛的研究和投资来解决登革热日益严重的负担,包括严重的 暴发 和地理传播。与此同时,加强监管参与创新治疗和预防措施的制定和评估至关重要,特别是在负担最重的低收入和中等收入地区。关于登革热及其影响的清晰沟通和教育,以及经证明具有良好耐受性和有效性的可用预防措施,对于加强信任、提高吸收率和最大限度地提高公共卫生影响也至关重要。

title: Battling dengue in a warming world: How climate and urbanization shape transmission in low- and middle-income countries (a rapid review).
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a globally prevalent vector-borne disease, with low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) experiencing a disproportionate burden. Transmission patterns are increasingly influenced by rising global temperatures and rapid urbanization, yet no recent review has synthesized how these environmental factors are reshaping dengue dynamics in LMICs. METHODS: We conducted a rapid systematic review following a registered protocol (PROSPERO: CRD42025635982). Six databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Global Health, SciELO, Global Index Medicus and Web of Science) were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and November 2024. Studies were screened for climate or urbanization factors affecting dengue transmission in LMICs. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool for empirical studies and a structured assessment for modeling studies. Findings were synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Of the 65 included studies, 65% reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, often attributed to intensified mosquito activity and longer transmission seasons. Urbanization was assessed in 35% of studies, with unplanned growth, informal settlements, and inadequate infrastructure frequently associated with increased risk. Several studies reported geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, as well as seasonal shifts, including earlier onset and prolonged transmission periods. Urban heat islands and land-use change were commonly associated with localized transmission hotspots. Government responses were documented in 29% of studies, though many were hindered by fragmented surveillance systems, limited cross-sector coordination, or insufficient integration of climate data into public health planning. CONCLUSION: Climate change and urbanization are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue in LMICs. Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed planning in resilient urban infrastructure to reduce future transmission risks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 给低收入和中等收入国家 (LMIC) 带来了不成比例的负担,这些国家的 传播 模式越来越受到全球气温上升和快速城市化的影响。本研究旨在综合这些环境因素如何重塑中低收入国家的登革热动态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项快速系统评价遵循注册方案(PROSPERO:CRD42025635982),包括 2020 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间发表的 65 项同行评审研究。该评价重点关注影响中低收入国家登革热 传播 的气候或城市化因素的研究。
elements_zh.methods: 检索了六个数据库,并使用用于实证研究的混合方法评估工具和用于建模研究的结构化评估来评估研究质量。对研究结果进行叙述性综合,以评估特定环境变量的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在纳入的 65 项研究中,65% 报告气温升高与登革热 传播 增加之间呈正相关,而 35% 评估城市化,将计划外增长和基础设施不足与风险增加联系起来。研究还记录了向高地和城郊地区的地理扩张、季节变化以及城市热岛和局部 传播 热点之间的关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,气候变化和城市化正在重塑中低收入国家登革热的时空动态。这篇综述提供了最新的证据综合,将这些环境驱动因素与 传播 范围扩大和季节延长联系起来。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 适应性应对措施需要在有弹性的城市基础设施内加强 监测 和气候知情规划,以减少未来的 监测 风险。研究结果强调需要将气候数据纳入公共卫生规划,以解决零散的 监测 系统问题。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制或证据基础强度的详细评估。该审查依赖于对不同方法和质量评估的研究进行叙述性综合。

abstract_zh: 背景:登革热 是一种全球流行的 媒介 传播疾病,低收入和中等收入国家 (LMIC) 承受着不成比例的负担。传播 模式越来越受到全球气温上升和快速城市化的影响,但最近没有综述综合这些环境因素如何重塑中低收入国家的登革热动态。方法:我们按照注册方案(PROSPERO:CRD42025635982)进行了快速系统评价。检索了六个数据库(MEDLINE、Embase、Global Health、SciELO、Global Index Medicus 和 Web of Science),查找 2020 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间发表的同行评审研究。研究筛选了影响中低收入国家登革热 传播 的气候或城市化因素。研究质量使用混合方法评估工具进行实证研究和结构化评估进行建模研究。调查结果以叙述方式综合。结果:在纳入的 65 项研究中,65% 报告称气温升高与登革热 传播 增加之间存在正相关关系,这通常归因于蚊子活动加剧和 传播 季节延长。35% 的研究对城市化进行了评估,无计划的增长、非正规住区和基础设施不足往往与风险增加相关。几项研究报告了向高地和城郊地区的地理扩张,以及季节性变化,包括更早的发病和更长的 传播 时期。城市热岛和土地利用变化通常与局部 传播 热点相关。29% 的研究记录了政府的应对措施,尽管许多研究受到零散的 监测 系统、有限的跨部门协调或气候数据未充分纳入公共卫生规划的阻碍。结论:气候变化和城市化正在重塑中低收入国家登革热的时空动态。适应性应对措施需要在弹性城市基础设施中加强 监测 和气候知情规划,以减少未来的 监测 风险。

analysis_zh.methods: 检索了六个数据库,并使用用于实证研究的混合方法评估工具和用于建模研究的结构化评估来评估研究质量。对研究结果进行叙述性综合,以评估特定环境变量的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在纳入的 65 项研究中,65% 报告气温升高与登革热 传播 增加之间呈正相关,而 35% 评估城市化,将计划外增长和基础设施不足与风险增加联系起来。研究还记录了向高地和城郊地区的地理扩张、季节变化以及城市热岛和局部 传播 热点之间的关联。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,气候变化和城市化正在重塑中低收入国家登革热的时空动态。这篇综述提供了最新的证据综合,将这些环境驱动因素与 传播 范围扩大和季节延长联系起来。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 适应性应对措施需要在有弹性的城市基础设施内加强 监测 和气候知情规划,以减少未来的 监测 风险。研究结果强调需要将气候数据纳入公共卫生规划,以解决零散的 监测 系统问题。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制或证据基础强度的详细评估。该审查依赖于对不同方法和质量评估的研究进行叙述性综合。

title: Congenital Dengue Infection during the Epidemic in Argentina in the 2023-2024 Period: A Multicenter Registry.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe clinical, laboratory, and follow-up characteristics of neonates with confirmed dengue infection. STUDY DESIGN: Observational, descriptive, retrospective, and multicenter study including neonates with confirmed congenital dengue hospitalized at six centers from Argentina, between July 2023 and July 2024. Confirmation required virological or serological testing in both mother and neonate. Data were collected anonymously via REDCap and analyzed with RStudio. RESULTS: A total of 58 neonates were included. Most pregnant individuals presented with fever, myalgia, and headache. Maternal diagnosis was confirmed mainly by NS1 antigen (59%) and PCR (43%); 9% were serotyped, with 4⁄5 serotypes corresponding to DENV1. In all 52 pregnant individuals were hospitalized. Median gestational age at birth was 38 weeks, and 21% of neonates were preterm. Most deliveries were cesarean. At admission, 74% of neonates were asymptomatic; 26% showed respiratory distress or temperature instability. Diagnosis was confirmed by PCR in 59% of neonates. Two preterm neonates required mechanical ventilation. Median hospital stay was 9 days. Within the first week of life, 57% of neonates developed thrombocytopenia. No deaths or sequelae were recorded in neonates. One mother died because of severe dengue with shock. CONCLUSION: In this multicenter registry, 74% of neonates were asymptomatic and 21% preterm, with no deaths or sequelae at discharge and 30 days of follow-up. KEY POINTS: · In 98% of pregnant individuals with dengue infection was mild, and one died.. · About 74% of neonates with congenital dengue were asymptomatic.. · Thrombocytopenia was seen in 57% of neonates within the first week of life with a peak at day 7..

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to describe the clinical, laboratory, and follow-up characteristics of neonates with confirmed congenital dengue infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This observational, descriptive, retrospective, and multicenter study included 58 neonates with confirmed congenital dengue hospitalized at six centers in Argentina between July 2023 and July 2024, alongside 52 pregnant individuals.
analysis.methods: Confirmation of infection required virological or serological testing in both mother and neonate, with maternal diagnosis primarily via NS1 antigen (59%) and PCR (43%), and neonatal diagnosis confirmed by PCR in 59% of cases; data were collected anonymously via REDCap and analyzed with RStudio.
analysis.main_results: Most pregnant individuals presented with fever, myalgia, and headache, and 98% had mild infection though one died from severe dengue with shock; 21% of neonates were preterm, 74% were asymptomatic at admission, and 57% developed thrombocytopenia within the first week of life with a peak at day 7.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as showing that the majority of neonates with congenital dengue were asymptomatic and that thrombocytopenia was a frequent finding, with no neonatal deaths or sequelae recorded at discharge and 30 days of follow-up.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform clinical management by highlighting that congenital dengue often presents asymptomatically in neonates but carries a risk of thrombocytopenia, while also noting the potential for severe maternal outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the retrospective, observational design which may be subject to selection and information bias, and the study relied on available clinical data without a control group.

analysis.summary_en: This multicenter registry study in Argentina described 58 neonates with confirmed congenital dengue infection hospitalized between July 2023 and July 2024. Infection was confirmed via virological or serological testing in both mothers and neonates. Results indicated that 21% of neonates were preterm and 74% were asymptomatic at admission, though 57% developed thrombocytopenia within the first week of life. While 98% of pregnant individuals had mild infection, one maternal death occurred due to severe dengue with shock. No neonatal deaths or sequelae were observed at discharge or during 30 days of follow-up.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在描述确诊先天性登革热感染新生儿的临床、实验室和随访特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项观察性、描述性、回顾性、多中心研究纳入了 2023 年 7 月至 2024 年 7 月期间在阿根廷六个中心住院的 58 名确诊患有先天性登革热的新生儿,以及 52 名孕妇。
elements_zh.methods: 确诊感染需要对母亲和新生儿进行病毒学或血清学检测,其中母亲诊断主要通过NS1抗原(59%)和PCR(43%)进行检测,新生儿诊断在59%的病例中通过PCR确诊;数据通过 REDCap 匿名收集并使用 RStudio 进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 大多数孕妇出现发烧、肌痛和头痛症状,98% 的人有轻度感染,但有 1 人因 重症登革热 休克死亡;21% 的新生儿早产,74% 入院时无症状,57% 在出生后第一周内出现血小板减少症,并在第 7 天达到高峰。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者对研究结果的解释是,大多数患有先天性登革热的新生儿没有症状,血小板减少症是常见现象,出院时和 30 天的随访中没有记录到新生儿死亡或后遗症。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调先天性登革热在新生儿中通常无症状,但具有血小板减少症的风险,为临床管理提供信息,同时也指出了严重孕产妇结局的可能性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于回顾性观察设计可能会受到选择和信息偏差的影响,证据强度中等,并且该研究依赖于现有的临床数据,没有对照组。

title: Molecular characterization and recent spread of dengue virus type 3 lineage III_B.3.2 in Brazil: in silico analysis of protein motifs and epidemiology
abstract: Abstract The dengue virus (DENV) belongs to the Flaviviridae family and is responsible for a febrile arbovirus disease of global relevance. In Brazil, there has been endemic circulation of the four viral serotypes since the last century, with DENV-3 being frequently associated with more severe clinical conditions and major epidemics. This study aimed to perform the motif characterization of DENV-3 strains circulating in Brazil and its epidemiology. We obtained cases information by serotype from DATASUS/TABNET from 2013 to 2025. Furthermore, 184 complete genomes of Brazilian samples available in the GenBank and GISAID databases were analyzed with the genome reference sequence of DENV-3 (NC_001475.2). The sequences were edited and analyzed with the MAFFT, BioEdit, Nextclade, and GeneDoc software to identify lineages and amino acid motifs and were subsequently submitted to phylogenetic analyses in the IQ-Tree and FigTree programs. analysis.summary_en: This study characterized the molecular motifs and epidemiology of DENV-3 strains circulating in Brazil using 184 complete genomes from GenBank and GISAID alongside national surveillance data from 2013 to 2025. Historically, DENV-1 was predominant, but DENV-3 cases surged in 2024 and surpassed DENV-1 by December 2025. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that lineage 3III_B.3.2, introduced in 2022, replaced previously dominant lineages and was associated with this increase. This lineage exhibited specific amino acid substitutions and the absence of certain protein motifs, which the authors suggest contributed to its replicative success. These findings underscore the value of genomic surveillance in monitoring evolving dengue threats and informing public health strategies.

abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒 (DENV) 属于黄病毒科,是导致全球相关性发热虫媒病毒病的原因。在巴西,自上世纪以来,四种病毒血清型一直在流行,其中 DENV-3 经常与更严重的临床病症和重大流行病相关。本研究旨在对巴西流行的 DENV-3 毒株及其 流行病学 进行基序表征。我们从 DATASUS/TABNET 中获取了 2013 年至 2025 年按血清型分类的病例信息。此外,利用 DENV-3 (NC_001475.2) 的 基因组 参考序列对 GenBank 和 GISAID 数据库中可用的 184 个巴西样本的完整 基因组 进行了分析。使用 MAFFT、BioEdit、Nextclade 和 GeneDoc 软件对序列进行编辑和分析,以识别谱系和氨基酸基序,然后提交到 IQ-Tree 和 FigTree 程序中进行系统发育分析。结果表明,血清型 1 历来占主导地位,但与前一年相比,2024 年 DENV-2 和 DENV-3 病例大幅增加。到2025年12月,DENV-3病例数已超过当年的DENV-1病例数。在整个 基因组 中鉴定出九个氨基酸基序,特别是 N-肉豆蔻酰化、酪蛋白激酶 II 磷酸化、蛋白激酶 C 磷酸化和 N-糖基化位点。直到 2022 年,主要谱系是 3III_C.2 和 3III_C.2.2,当时巴西引入了 3III_B.3.2 谱系,这与病例的增加有关。与之前的谱系相比,该基因型出现了替换并且缺乏蛋白质基序,表明这种改变有助于其复制成功。

title: Molecular and biophysical requirements for B cell receptor-dependent enhancement of dengue virus infection
abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) is the causative agent of dengue, a mosquito-borne disease that represents a significant and growing public health burden around the world. A unique pathophysiological feature of dengue is immune-mediated enhancement, wherein preexisting immunity elicited by a primary infection can enhance the severity of a subsequent infection by a heterologous DENV serotype. A leading mechanistic explanation for this phenomenon is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells. Accordingly, this model posits that phagocytic mononuclear cells are the primary reservoir of DENV. However, multiple independent groups have shown that B cells are the largest reservoir of virally infected cells in circulation during acute dengue, representing a disconnect in our understanding of immune-mediated DENV tropism. In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. In this study, we show that DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Finally, we show that immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes. We propose that BDE provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis. IMPORTANCE This study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Immune-mediated enhancement of infection is a cornerstone of dengue immunopathogenesis and is most often attributed to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). BCR-dependent enhancement of DENV infection is an alternative and complementary mechanism for immune-mediated enhancement that addresses several persistent knowledge gaps in the dengue field and may offer mechanistic insight into why some people progress to severe dengue after infection.

A leading mechanistic explanation for this phenomenon is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells. Accordingly, this model posits that phagocytic mononuclear cells are the primary reservoir of DENV. However, multiple independent groups have shown that B cells are the largest reservoir of virally infected cells in circulation during acute dengue, representing a disconnect in our understanding of immune-mediated DENV tropism. In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. In this study, we show that DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Finally, we show that immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes. We propose that BDE provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis.IMPORTANCEThis study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Immune-mediated enhancement of infection is a cornerstone of dengue immunopathogenesis and is most often attributed to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). BCR-dependent enhancement of DENV infection is an alternative and complementary mechanism for immune-mediated enhancement that addresses several persistent knowledge gaps in the dengue field and may offer mechanistic insight into why some people progress to severe dengue after infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of dengue virus (DENV) infection to address the disconnect where B cells are the largest reservoir of infected cells during acute dengue despite the focus on antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Using immortalized DENV-reactive B cells and live DENV, researchers found that infection is highly sensitive to BCR and DENV envelope protein interactions. The entry process is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. The results demonstrate that these B cells support active viral replication of all four DENV serotypes. The authors propose that BDE complements ADE, offering a new mechanistic explanation for DENV immunopathogenesis and progression to severe disease.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 抗体依赖性增强 (DENV) 是一个重大的公共卫生负担,预先存在的免疫力会增强随后异源感染的严重性,这种现象通常归因于 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE)。这项研究解决了有关免疫介导的 DENV 趋向性机制的知识空白,特别研究了 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性增强 (BDE),因为 B 细胞是急性登革热期间感染细胞中最大的 储存宿主。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 提供的证据没有报告具体的研究日期、中心或样本量。该研究利用永生化的 DENV 反应性 B 细胞和活 DENV 来研究所有四种血清型的感染机制。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究评估了 DENV 感染对 BCR 和 DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白相互作用的敏感性,并描述了进入过程。方法包括确定 DENV 反应性 B 细胞病毒感染期间对动力介导的进入、近端 BCR 信号传导以及晚期内体定位的需求。
elements_zh.main_results: 发现 DENV 反应性 B 细胞的 DENV 感染对 BCR/DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白相互作用高度敏感。进入该 B 细胞亚群的过程是动力介导的,需要近端 BCR 信号传导,并涉及晚期内体的定位。永生化的 DENV 反应性 B 细胞被活 DENV 有效感染,支持所有四种血清型的活跃病毒复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者提出,BCR 依赖性增强 (BDE) 提供了一层额外的病原体特异性免疫介导的感染风险,补充了现有的 ADE 模型。这种机制为 DENV 免疫发病机制提供了新的见解,并解释了为什么一些个体在感染后进展为 重症登革热。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了 B 细胞受体依赖性 DENV 感染增强的机制见解,这可能解释了一些患者进展为 重症登革热 的情况。该研究表明,BDE 补充了 ADE 模型,有可能为未来对登革热免疫发病机制的理解提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告有关样本量、对照或普遍性的具体限制。证据强度被评估为中等,因为结果来自永生化细胞系而不是原代细胞或体内模型。

abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒 (DENV) 是登革热的病原体,登革热是一种蚊媒疾病,给全世界带来了巨大且日益严重的公共卫生负担。登革热的一个独特的病理生理学特征是免疫介导的增强,其中由原发感染引起的预先存在的免疫力可以增强异源DENV血清型的后续感染的严重性。这种现象的一个主要机制解释是 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE),其中亚中和浓度的 DENV 特异性 IgG 抗体有利于 DENV 进入表达 FcγR 的细胞。因此,该模型假设吞噬性单核细胞是 DENV 的主要 储存宿主。然而,多个独立研究小组表明,B 细胞是急性登革热期间循环中病毒感染细胞中最大的 储存宿主,这表明我们对免疫介导的 DENV 趋向性的理解存在脱节。为了应对这种持续存在的知识差距,我们的团队之前发现了一种免疫介导增强的新机制,我们将其称为 DENV 感染的 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性增强 (BDE)。在这项研究中,我们发现 DENV 反应性 B 细胞的 DENV 感染对 BCR/DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白相互作用高度敏感。DENV 进入 B 细胞亚群是由动力介导的,需要近端 BCR 信号传导,并涉及晚期内体的定位。最后,我们证明永生化的 DENV 反应性 B 细胞可以被活 DENV 有效感染,能够支持所有四种血清型的活跃病毒复制。我们认为,BDE 提供了一层额外的病原体特异性免疫介导的感染风险,补充了现有的 ADE 模型,并为 DENV 免疫发病机制的潜在机制提供了更多见解。重要性 这项研究提供了对 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染增强过程的机制见解。免疫介导的感染增强是登革热免疫发病机制的基石,最常归因于 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE)。DENV 感染的 BCR 依赖性增强是免疫介导增强的一种替代和补充机制,它解决了登革热领域中几个持续存在的知识空白,并可能为为什么有些人在感染后进展到 重症登革热 提供机制见解。

abstract: Following the COVID-19 pandemic, dengue fever, one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases, has become a serious public health challenge in many countries around the world in recent years.Transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, this disease is prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions.Iran is also at risk of spreading this disease despite being located in a region with a predominantly arid and semi-arid climate.Recent reports of local cases of dengue fever in Hormozgan province, especially in Bandar Lengeh city, are a wake-up call for the country's health system.Dengue fever is an emerging threat to public health in Iran that requires urgent and coordinated action.Controlling this disease requires the participation of all sectors of society, including the government, health institutions, and the public.By implementing scientific and sustainable strategies and in coordination with government agencies, Iran can be prevented from becoming an endemic area for dengue fever.

title: Dengue Fever Complicated by Acute Acalculous Cholecystitis and Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis Despite Negative PCR.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of dengue fever complicated by acute acalculous cholecystitis (AAC) and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), despite initial negative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) results. METHODS: We describe the clinical course of a 40-year-old woman who returned from Indonesia with a persistent fever and rash. The diagnosis was established through clinical evaluation, serological testing, and abdominal imaging. The study conformed to the principles outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. RESULTS: Although the initial dengue PCR result was negative, subsequent NS1 and IgM antibody test results were positive. The patient developed severe complications, including AAC, characterized by gallbladder wall thickening, and HLH, indicated by marked fever, splenomegaly, hypofibrinogenemia, hyperferritinemia, and high soluble IL-2 receptor levels. Despite these symptoms, the patient was managed conservatively. Planned percutaneous transhepatic gallbladder aspiration was canceled because of spontaneous improvement observed on ultrasonography. The patient recovered fully without corticosteroid or platelet transfusions and was discharged on day 14. CONCLUSION: Given the potential for false-negative PCR results during the acute phase of dengue, multimodal serological testing is essential. This case demonstrates that severe atypical complications, such as AAC and HLH, can be resolved with supportive care alone, avoiding invasive procedures, immunosuppressive therapy, and platelet transfusion.

title_zh: 登革热 尽管 PCR 呈阴性,但仍并发急性非结石性胆囊炎和噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of dengue fever complicated by acute acalculous cholecystitis (AAC) and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), despite initial negative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) results. METHODS: We describe the clinical course of a 40-year-old woman who returned from Indonesia with a persistent fever and rash. The diagnosis was established through clinical evaluation, serological testing, and abdominal imaging. The study conformed to the principles outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. RESULTS: Although the initial dengue PCR result was negative, subsequent NS1 and IgM antibody test results were positive. The patient developed severe complications, including AAC, characterized by gallbladder wall thickening, and HLH, indicated by marked fever, splenomegaly, hypofibrinogenemia, hyperferritinemia, and high soluble IL-2 receptor levels. Despite these symptoms, the patient was managed conservatively. Planned percutaneous transhepatic gallbladder aspiration was canceled because of spontaneous improvement observed on ultrasonography. The patient recovered fully without corticosteroid or platelet transfusions and was discharged on day 14. CONCLUSION: Given the potential for false-negative PCR results during the acute phase of dengue, multimodal serological testing is essential. This case demonstrates that severe atypical complications, such as AAC and HLH, can be resolved with supportive care alone, avoiding invasive procedures, immunosuppressive therapy, and platelet transfusion.

title: Impaired Consciousness, Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS), and Multiorgan Dysfunction Syndrome (MODS) As the Triad of Mortality in Severe Dengue: Evidence From 100 Consecutive ICU Admissions
abstract: Background Severe dengue is a leading contributor to intensive care unit (ICU) admissions and death in tropical regions. Identifying factors associated with poor outcomes early is critical for guiding treatment and allocating resources in critically ill patients. Methods This prospective observational cohort enrolled 100 consecutive patients with WHO 2009-defined severe dengue admitted to the ICU and Emergency Department of Maharishi Markandeshwar Institute of Medical Science and Research (MMIMSR), Mullana, Haryana, between March 2025 and January 2026. Clinical, laboratory, and severity-score data (Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II (APACHE II), Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA)) were recorded and compared between survivors and non-survivors using appropriate statistical tests, relative risks (RR) with 95% CI, and ROC analysis. Results The mean age was 47.2 ± 17.5 years; 58% were male. ICU mortality was 21.0% (21/100). Thrombocytopenia showed no mortality link (p = 0.678). Higher pulse rate, respiratory rate, body temperature, total leucocyte count, creatinine, bilirubin, and lactate, together with lower blood pressure, Glasgow Coma scale (GCS) score, arterial pH, and PaO2, were each associated with ICU mortality (all p 2 cm was significant (50.0% vs. 17.0% mortality; RR 2.93, 95% CI 1.41-6.09; p = 0.024). Impaired consciousness (72.4% vs. 0% mortality; RR 103.20, 95% CI 6.46-1649.18; p < 0.001), acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS; 100% vs. 12.2%; RR 7.55, 95% CI 4.33-13.16; p < 0.001), and multiorgan dysfunction syndrome (MODS; 76.9% vs. 12.6%; RR 6.08, 95% CI 3.25-11.39; p = 0.002) showed the strongest associations (φ = 0.807, 0.647, 0.531 respectively). APACHE II (AUC 0.935) and SOFA (AUC 0.938) had the best discriminative accuracy, followed by lactate (AUC 0.835) and arterial pH (AUC 0.824). Conclusions Impaired consciousness, ARDS, and MODS strongly predicted mortality in this severe dengue cohort, forming a clinically vital cluster for early risk stratification. These single-center findings question the thrombocytopenia-centric paradigm and support closer attention to neurological status and organ dysfunction from ICU admission onward.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项前瞻性观察性 队列研究 纳入了 100 名连续 2025 年 3 月至 2026 年 1 月期间入住哈里亚纳邦穆拉纳 Maharishi Markandeshwar 医学科学研究所 (MMIMSR) 的 ICU 和急诊科的 WHO 2009 定义的 重症登革热 患者。

title: Beyond neutralization: A comprehensive framework for evaluating humoral immunity induced by a live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Dengue incidence is increasing worldwide. TAK-003, a live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine, is licensed in several countries. Its safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity have been extensively studied and provided the roadmap for recommendations and implementation. Per WHO guidelines, the primary immunogenicity endpoint in dengue vaccine clinical trials is neutralizing antibody (NAb) titers. However, there is no established immunological correlate of protection, and dengue virus (DENV) elicits a broad range of antibody responses. This study assessed statistical and experimental methods to evaluate a wide range of antibody responses to TAK-003 as a framework for evaluating vaccine immunological signatures that may correlate with protection from dengue infection and/or disease. METHODS: Responses were assessed by the following immunoassays: microneutralization assay, DENV total binding IgG ELISA, anti-dengue complement antibody assay, anti-dengue non-structural protein 1 (NS1) IgG ELISA, and anti-dengue IgG avidity assay. Samples from TAK-003 vaccinated/placebo participants from several trials were tested. Results were compared for assay performance and the impact of baseline serostatus, serotype, and age on vaccine-elicited responses. Correlation analyses assessed relationships among variables. Principal component analyses (PCA) evaluated data complexity. RESULTS: Vaccination elicited responses to all four DENV serotypes in each assay. The magnitude of vaccine-induced responses was higher in baseline seropositive participants, but vaccine effect was stronger in baseline seronegative participants. Baseline seronegative participants had comparable DENV total binding IgG concentrations, anti-dengue IgG avidity, and anti-dengue complement antibody titer responses across all serotypes. MNT50 NAb and anti-dengue NS1 IgG responses varied by serotype. Modest to low correlations across parameters suggest that the different assays measure non-redundant vaccine-induced humoral immune responses. The major source of response variability was post-vaccination time, followed by serotype. CONCLUSION: TAK-003 vaccination elicited multiple non-overlapping, unique humoral immune responses. Data support including parameters in addition to NAbs to better assess vaccine-induced humoral responses. CLINICALTRIALS: govregistration:NCT01511250, NCT02302066, NCT02747927, NCT03423173.

title_zh: 超越中和:评估减毒活四价登革热 疫苗 诱导体液免疫的综合框架
source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: Dengue incidence is increasing worldwide. TAK-003, a live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine, is licensed in several countries. Its safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity have been extensively studied and provided the roadmap for recommendations and implementation. Per WHO guidelines, the primary immunogenicity endpoint in dengue vaccine clinical trials is neutralizing antibody (NAb) titers. However, there is no established immunological correlate of protection, and dengue virus (DENV) elicits a broad range of antibody responses. This study assessed statistical and experimental methods to evaluate a wide range of antibody responses to TAK-003 as a framework for evaluating vaccine immunological signatures that may correlate with protection from dengue infection and/or disease. METHODS: Responses were assessed by the following immunoassays: microneutralization assay, DENV total binding IgG ELISA, anti-dengue complement antibody assay, anti-dengue non-structural protein 1 (NS1) IgG ELISA, and anti-dengue IgG avidity assay. Samples from TAK-003 vaccinated/placebo participants from several trials were tested. Results were compared for assay performance and the impact of baseline serostatus, serotype, and age on vaccine-elicited responses. Correlation analyses assessed relationships among variables. Principal component analyses (PCA) evaluated data complexity. RESULTS: Vaccination elicited responses to all four DENV serotypes in each assay. The magnitude of vaccine-induced responses was higher in baseline seropositive participants, but vaccine effect was stronger in baseline seronegative participants. Baseline seronegative participants had comparable DENV total binding IgG concentrations, anti-dengue IgG avidity, and anti-dengue complement antibody titer responses across all serotypes. MNT50 NAb and anti-dengue NS1 IgG responses varied by serotype. Modest to low correlations across parameters suggest that the different assays measure non-redundant vaccine-induced humoral immune responses. The major source of response variability was post-vaccination time, followed by serotype. CONCLUSION: TAK-003 vaccination elicited multiple non-overlapping, unique humoral immune responses. Data support including parameters in addition to NAbs to better assess vaccine-induced humoral responses. CLINICALTRIALS: govregistration:NCT01511250, NCT02302066, NCT02747927, NCT03423173.
abstract_zh: 目标:登革热 发病率 在全球范围内不断增加。TAK-003 是一种减毒活四价登革热 疫苗,已在多个国家/地区获得许可。其安全性、有效性和免疫原性已得到广泛研究,并为建议和实施提供了路线图。根据 WHO 指南,登革热 疫苗 临床试验的主要免疫原性终点是中和抗体 (NAb) 滴度。然而,保护的免疫学相关性尚未确定,登革病毒 (DENV) 会引发广泛的抗体反应。本研究评估了统计和实验方法,以评估对 TAK-003 的各种抗体反应,作为评估可能与预防登革热感染和/或疾病相关的 疫苗 免疫学特征的框架。方法:通过以下免疫测定评估反应:微量中和测定、DENV 总结合 IgG ELISA、抗登革热补体抗体测定、抗登革热非结构蛋白 1 (NS1) IgG ELISA 和抗登革热 IgG 亲合力测定。对来自多项试验的 TAK-003 疫苗接种/安慰剂参与者的样本进行了测试。比较结果的测定性能以及基线血清状态、血清型和年龄对 疫苗 引发的反应的影响。相关分析评估变量之间的关系。主成分分析 (PCA) 评估数据复杂性。结果:疫苗接种 在每次检测中均引发对所有四种 DENV 血清型的反应。在基线血清阳性参与者中,疫苗 诱导的反应程度较高,但在基线血清阴性参与者中,疫苗 效应更强。基线血清阴性参与者在所有血清型中具有相当的 DENV 总结合 IgG 浓度、抗登革热 IgG 亲合力和抗登革热补体抗体滴度反应。MNT50 NAb 和抗登革热 NS1 IgG 反应因血清型而异。参数之间的中等到低相关性表明不同的测定测量非冗余 疫苗 诱导的体液 免疫应答。反应变异的主要来源是 疫苗接种 后的时间,其次是血清型。结论:TAK-003 疫苗接种 引发多个非重叠、独特的体液 免疫应答。数据支持包括除 NAb 之外的参数,以更好地评估 疫苗 诱导的体液反应。临床试验:政府注册:NCT01511250、NCT02302066、NCT02747927、NCT03423173。

title: Deep learning with LSTM networks for dengue disease forecasting and control
abstract: Abstract Accurate forecasting of infectious disease dynamics is essential for effective public health planning and early outbreak response. Traditional statistical models and modern deep learning approaches have both been widely used for epidemiological time–series forecasting. Dengue fever remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh, where seasonal outbreaks often produce sharp and unpredictable infection spikes. Reliable forecasting models are therefore important for anticipating infection trends and supporting early intervention strategies. This study investigates the performance of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for predicting daily dengue infection counts in Bangladesh using surveillance data from 2010 to 2022. Multiple LSTM architectures were developed by varying the number of LSTM units, lookback window size, and data preprocessing strategies. A fixed time-based data split was used, with training data up to 30 September 2021 and testing on subsequent observations to avoid information leakage. The proposed LSTM models were compared with several baseline forecasting approaches, including Naive, Seasonal-Naive, and ARIMA models. Model performance was evaluated using standard forecasting metrics including Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE). Experimental results indicate that classical statistical models remain strong benchmarks for dengue forecasting. Among all evaluated models, the ARIMA(2,1,2) model achieved the best predictive performance on the test dataset with MAE of 8.40 and RMSE of 14.72. The best-performing LSTM configuration produced competitive results with MAE of 8.92 and RMSE of 15.87, outperforming simple baseline approaches such as the Naive and Seasonal-Naive models. These findings suggest that while deep learning models are capable of capturing complex temporal patterns, their advantage over well-tuned statistical models is not guaranteed for this dataset. The results highlight the importance of benchmarking deep learning models against classical time-series approaches when forecasting epidemiological data. While LSTM networks demonstrate promising performance in modeling nonlinear temporal dynamics, the ARIMA model provided the most accurate predictions for the studied dengue dataset.

title: Clinical Profile and Treatment Patterns of Dengue Patients Admitted to a Tertiary Care Hospital in Bangladesh: a Hospital-Based Observational Study
abstract: In Bangladesh, dengue is a serious public health issue that spreads quickly through mosquitoes and usually necessitates hospitalization for supportive care. The purpose of this hospital-based observational study was to assess the clinical presentation, treatment methods, hospitalization trends and sociodemographic profile of 205 dengue patients who were admitted to a tertiary care hospital in Dhaka. Young adults, aged 21 to 30 years, accounted for the highest percentage of cases, indicating their significant affliction. Dengue hemorrhagic fever (10.24%) and dengue shock syndrome (2.93%) were the next most common causes of hospitalization, after dengue fever (86.82%). Patients from outside of Dhaka constituted a larger percentage of severe cases and had longer hospital stays; part of the variation in hospitalization duration was explained by demographic characteristics (R2 = 0.2505). High fever (82.93%), nausea and vomiting (45.37%), headache (40%), bleeding (21.95%), and shock (8.78%) were the most frequent clinical symptoms. The mainstay of treatment was fluid therapy, with 45.36% of patients receiving normal saline along with dextrose preparations and 32.68% receiving 5% DNS. When clinically necessary, antihistamines, antibiotics and antiemetics were taken in addition to paracetamol (82.93%), multivitamin supplements (90.73%) and Carica papaya leaf extract (75.6%). To enhance outcomes and direct dengue control methods in Bangladesh, the data from this research highlights current hospitalization trends and stresses the significance of prompt, supportive care in the clinical management of dengue cases. Bangladesh Pharmaceutical Journal 29(2): 215-227, 2026 (July)

The purpose of this hospital-based observational study was to assess the clinical presentation, treatment methods, hospitalization trends and sociodemographic profile of 205 dengue patients who were admitted to a tertiary care hospital in Dhaka. Young adults, aged 21 to 30 years, accounted for the highest percentage of cases, indicating their significant affliction. Dengue hemorrhagic fever (10.24%) and dengue shock syndrome (2.93%) were the next most common causes of hospitalization, after dengue fever (86.82%). Patients from outside of Dhaka constituted a larger percentage of severe cases and had longer hospital stays; part of the variation in hospitalization duration was explained by demographic characteristics (R2 = 0.2505). High fever (82.93%), nausea and vomiting (45.37%), headache (40%), bleeding (21.95%), and shock (8.78%) were the most frequent clinical symptoms. The mainstay of treatment was fluid therapy, with 45.36% of patients receiving normal saline along with dextrose preparations and 32.68% receiving 5% DNS. When clinically necessary, antihistamines, antibiotics and antiemetics were taken in addition to paracetamol (82.93%), multivitamin supplements (90.73%) and Carica papaya leaf extract (75.6%). To enhance outcomes and direct dengue control methods in Bangladesh, the data from this research highlights current hospitalization trends and stresses the significance of prompt, supportive care in the clinical management of dengue cases. Bangladesh Pharmaceutical Journal 29(2): 215-227, 2026 (July)

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue poses a serious public health burden in Bangladesh, often requiring hospitalization for supportive care, yet detailed clinical and treatment data remain limited. This study aimed to characterize the clinical presentation, treatment patterns, and sociodemographic profile of hospitalized dengue patients to inform local management and control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A hospital-based observational study was conducted at a tertiary care hospital in Dhaka, Bangladesh, enrolling 205 laboratory-confirmed dengue patients admitted during the study period. The study described sociodemographic characteristics, clinical features, and hospitalization trends among these patients.
analysis.methods: The study retrospectively analyzed medical records to extract demographic data, clinical symptoms, disease severity classifications, and treatment regimens. Hospitalization duration was modeled against demographic variables using linear regression (R2 = 0.2505) to assess factors influencing length of stay.
analysis.main_results: Among 205 patients, dengue fever accounted for 86.82%, dengue hemorrhagic fever for 10.24%, and dengue shock syndrome for 2.93%. The most frequent symptoms were high fever (82.93%), nausea and vomiting (45.37%), headache (40%), bleeding (21.95%), and shock (8.78%). Fluid therapy was the mainstay, with 45.36% receiving normal saline with dextrose and 32.68% receiving 5% DNS.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the predominance of young adults among hospitalized cases and underscores the importance of prompt supportive care, particularly fluid resuscitation, in managing dengue. It provides locally relevant data on clinical profiles and treatment patterns that can guide dengue control efforts in Bangladesh.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform hospital-based dengue management protocols, prioritize resource allocation for severe cases, and support targeted public health interventions to reduce hospitalization burden in Bangladesh.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a single-center, retrospective observational study, the findings may not be generalizable to other settings and are subject to selection and information biases. The moderate explanatory power of the regression model (R2 = 0.2505) further limits causal inference, warranting cautious interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This hospital-based observational study in Dhaka, Bangladesh, analyzed 205 dengue patients to characterize clinical presentations, treatment patterns, and sociodemographic profiles. Dengue fever was the most common diagnosis (86.82%), followed by dengue hemorrhagic fever (10.24%) and dengue shock syndrome (2.93%). High fever, nausea/vomiting, headache, bleeding, and shock were the predominant symptoms. Fluid therapy was the primary treatment, with normal saline with dextrose and 5% DNS most frequently used. Young adults aged 21–30 years represented the largest proportion of cases. The study emphasizes the need for prompt supportive care and highlights hospitalization trends to guide local dengue control strategies. Limitations include single-center design, retrospective data collection, and modest explanatory power of demographic factors for hospitalization duration.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热在孟加拉国造成严重的公共卫生负担,通常需要住院接受支持性护理,但详细的临床和 治疗 数据仍然有限。本研究旨在描述住院登革热患者的临床表现、治疗 模式和社会人口学特征,为当地管理和控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 孟加拉国达卡的一家三级护理医院进行了一项以医院为基础的观察性研究,招募了研究期间入院的 205 名实验室确诊的登革热患者。该研究描述了这些患者的社会人口学特征、临床特征和住院趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究回顾性分析了医疗记录,以提取人口统计数据、临床症状、疾病严重程度分类和 治疗 方案。使用线性回归(R2 = 0.2505)根据人口变量对住院时间进行建模,以评估影响住院时间的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 205例患者中,登革热占86.82%,登革出血热占10.24%,登革休克综合征占2.93%。最常见的症状是高烧(82.93%)、恶心呕吐(45.37%)、头痛(40%)、出血(21.95%)和休克(8.78%)。液体疗法是主要疗法,45.36% 的患者接受生理盐水加葡萄糖,32.68% 的患者接受 5% DNS。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了住院病例中年轻人的主导地位,并强调了及时支持治疗(特别是液体复苏)在管理登革热方面的重要性。它提供了有关临床概况和 治疗 模式的当地相关数据,可以指导孟加拉国的登革热控制工作。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为基于医院的登革热管理方案提供信息,优先分配重症病例的资源,并支持有针对性的公共卫生干预措施,以减轻孟加拉国的住院负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项单中心、回顾性观察研究,研究结果可能无法推广到其他环境,并且会受到选择和信息偏差的影响。回归模型的中等解释力(R2 = 0.2505)进一步限制了因果推断,需要谨慎解释。

title: A Dendrimer-Based Multiple Antigenic Peptide (MAP) Approach for Dengue Vaccine Development: In Silico and In Vivo Insights on Safety and Effectiveness
abstract: Dengue fever, a rapidly spreading mosquito-borne viral disease, poses a major global health issue, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions. The absence of a universally effective vaccine against all four dengue virus serotypes necessitates continued exploration of novel vaccine strategies. This study evaluated a PrM-derived multiple antigenic peptide (MAP) vaccine candidate in BALB/c mice. Molecular docking analyses predicted favourable interactions of the selected PrM-derived B-cell epitope with both human (human BCR Fab region PDB ID: 5IFH) and mouse (mouse BCR PDB ID: 8EMA) B-cell receptors, supporting its antigenic potential. ChemSketch was used to develop the PrM–MAP vaccine construct, which was then commercially synthesized. Mice received single, double, and triple booster doses of the vaccine, while control groups received either PBS or adjuvant alone. Humoral immune responses were measured by ELISA, and safety was evaluated through in vitro cytotoxicity assays on HEK293 cells and the in vivo histopathological examination of major organs. Mice immunized with a single booster dose produced significant levels of PrM-specific antibodies compared to subsequent booster doses, suggesting variability in the humoral response elicited. Optimal coating concentrations in ELISA demonstrated the importance of antigen concentrations in the sensitivity of the assay. The safety evaluation indicated high cell viability, up to 150 μg/mL of PrM–MAP, in HEK293 cells, and an absence of significant histopathological damage in treated animals. The PrM–MAP vaccine construct elicited a detectable humoral immune response while demonstrating a high safety profile in vitro and in vivo. These findings indicate the potential of MAP-based vaccine platforms as promising candidates for further development against the dengue virus.

title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Dengue Risk in Bangladesh: A GIS Based Approach.
abstract: Dengue, commonly known as breakbone fever, has been prevalent in Bangladesh since 2000. Monsoon conditions and warmer temperatures create suitable breeding environment for the vectors Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Although dengue outbreaks peak during the post-monsoon months (September and October), 2023 showed an unusual shift, with cases peaking as early as June. The case fatality rate (0.54%) in 2023 was the highest in the past two decades. This study offers an exhaustive examination of the spatiotemporal dynamics of dengue incidence clusters and composite risk across Bangladesh using daily dengue case data from 2019 to 2024. Spatial autocorrelation analysis (Local Moran's I) revealed that the central and south coastal districts, especially Dhaka, Manikganj, and Barisal were the major dengue hotspots during the peak outbreak years (2019, 2023, and 2024). Jaccard Similarity Index (JSI) analysis further indicated strong seasonal and interannual reorganization of dengue hotspots, especially during the post-monsoon season, with increasing hotspot concentration in coastal districts after 2020. To assess hazard, vulnerability and risk, we applied a GIS-based multi-criteria decision-making model (MCDM) framework and compared both weighted (AHP-based) and unweighted approaches. The weighted AHP model was more accurate (AUC = 0.75) than the unweighted model (AUC = 0.55) in predicting dengue risk zones. A negative binomial mixed-effects regression showed that lagged temperature, precipitation and population density increased dengue incidence, while higher normalized difference built-up index was associated with lower incidence. These findings emphasize the need for integrated dengue control strategies targeting high-risk areas and equal healthcare access.

title: Shared evidence, different recommendations: a comparative analysis of Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine guidance for travellers across countries
abstract: Abstract Background Dengue is an increasingly important cause of illness in travellers, and Qdenga (TAK-003) is the first dengue vaccine incorporated into guidance for travellers in multiple countries. However, clinicians and travellers may encounter differing recommendations across jurisdictions. This study compared guidance on the use of Qdenga in travellers across countries. Methods We conducted a comparative analysis of national guidance on Qdenga use for travellers across countries, using survey data and structured review of publicly available recommendations. Guidance was synthesised according to dengue immune status and mapped across recurring decision domains. Results Survey responses were obtained from 18 advisory bodies across 17 countries between March and April 2026, including twelve non-endemic countries where Qdenga was licensed and guidance published. Guidance was generally more restrictive than regulatory authorisation. While there was broad agreement in recommending vaccination for travellers with laboratory-confirmed prior dengue infection, recommendations for those without documented infection varied widely. All advisory bodies considered destination-specific dengue risk but differed in whether and how they used travel duration, repeated or cumulative exposure, traveller characteristics and host susceptibility factors to determine vaccine eligibility. Some recommendations restricted vaccination to travellers with prior dengue infection, whereas others extended eligibility to selected travellers without documented prior infection or recommended vaccination irrespective of serostatus based on exposure risk. Approaches also differed in assessment of prior dengue infection and whether completion of the two-dose series before travel was required. Conclusions Variation in Qdenga guidance reflects differences in how advisory bodies interpret shared evidence and manage uncertainty arising from data gaps and differences between trial populations and travellers. Additional data on vaccine effectiveness and clinical outcomes among seronegative travellers and older adults may help reduce uncertainty and support greater alignment of future recommendations. Regardless, transparency and shared clinical decision-making remain essential when discussing dengue vaccination with travellers.

While there is consensus on vaccinating travellers with prior dengue infection, recommendations for seronegative individuals vary significantly, with guidance generally being more restrictive than regulatory authorisation. abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热是旅行者中日益重要的疾病原因,Qdenga (TAK-003) 是第一个纳入多个国家旅行者指南的登革热 疫苗。然而,临床医生和旅行者可能会在不同司法管辖区遇到不同的建议。这项研究比较了各国旅行者使用 Qdenga 的指南。方法 我们利用调查数据和对公开建议的结构化审查,对各国旅行者使用 Qdenga 的国家指南进行了比较分析。根据登革热免疫状态合成指南,并在重复决策域中进行映射。结果 2026 年 3 月至 4 月期间,从 17 个国家的 18 个咨询机构获得了调查回复,其中包括 Qdenga 获得许可并发布指南的 12 个非流行国家。指导通常比监管授权更具限制性。虽然人们普遍同意向实验室确诊的既往登革热感染者推荐 疫苗接种,但对于没有感染记录的旅行者的建议差异很大。所有咨询机构都考虑了目的地特定的登革热风险,但在是否以及如何使用旅行持续时间、重复或累积暴露、旅行者特征和 宿主 易感因素来确定 疫苗 资格方面有所不同。一些建议将 疫苗接种 限制为既往感染过登革热的旅行者,而另一些建议将资格扩大到没有既往感染记录的特定旅行者,或根据暴露风险推荐 疫苗接种,无论血清状态如何。在评估既往登革热感染以及是否需要在旅行前完成两剂系列疫苗方面,方法也有所不同。结论 Qdenga 指南的差异反映了咨询机构如何解释共享证据以及管理因数据差距以及试验人群和旅行者之间的差异而产生的不确定性的差异。关于 疫苗 在血清阴性旅行者和老年人中的有效性和临床结果的更多数据可能有助于减少不确定性并支持未来建议的更大一致性。无论如何,在与旅行者讨论登革热 疫苗接种 时,透明度和共同的临床决策仍然至关重要。

title: Delayed Plasma Leakage Associated with Dengue Infection: A Case Report
abstract: Dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF) is characterized by plasma leakage during the critical phase of illness, typically occurring around defervescence between illness days 4 and 7. Delayed plasma leakage beyond this period is rarely described. We report a diagnostically challenging case of dengue in a previously healthy young woman from a dengue-endemic region, in whom plasma leakage was detected on illness day 13, raising the possibility of a delayed critical phase, though a sequential febrile illness followed by dengue infection could not be excluded. The patient initially developed high-grade fever, vomiting, arthralgia, and myalgia, which resolved after three days. After a three-day period of transient clinical improvement, severe headache, abdominal pain, and recurrent vomiting developed without recurrence of fever. She was admitted on day 12 with thrombocytopenia and marked transaminitis. On day 13 of illness, ultrasonography demonstrated free fluid in the hepatorenal pouch and right pleural cavity, consistent with plasma leakage, while dengue IgM and IgG antibodies were positive. The patient was managed as DHF with careful fluid monitoring and recovered uneventfully. This case highlights the importance of considering dengue in patients from endemic settings even when presentation is atypical, afebrile, or temporally delayed. Although a delayed critical phase is possible, sequential febrile illnesses with subsequent dengue infection could not be excluded because early virological confirmation was unavailable. Careful monitoring for thrombocytopenia and plasma leakage remains essential even in apparently recovering patients.

abstract_zh: 登革出血热 (DHF) 的特点是疾病关键阶段的血浆渗漏,通常发生在疾病第 4 天和第 7 天之间退热期间。在此期间之后的延迟血浆渗漏很少被描述。我们报告了一例诊断上具有挑战性的登革热病例,患者来自登革热流行地区,一名先前健康的年轻女性,在患病第 13 天检测到血浆渗漏,增加了关键期延迟的可能性,但不能排除随后出现登革热感染的连续发热性疾病。患者最初出现高烧、呕吐、关节痛和肌痛,三天后消退。经过三天的短暂临床改善后,出现严重头痛、腹痛和反复呕吐,但没有再次发烧。她于第 12 天因血小板减少症和明显的转氨炎入院。发病第13天,超声检查显示肝肾袋和右侧胸膜腔内有游离液体,与血浆渗漏一致,而登革热IgM和IgG抗体呈阳性。该患者接受了 DHF 治疗,并进行了仔细的液体监测,并顺利康复。该病例强调了在流行地区患者中考虑登革热的重要性,即使症状不典型、无发热或暂时延迟。尽管关键期可能会延迟,但由于无法获得早期病毒学确认,因此不能排除随后出现登革热感染的连续发热性疾病。即使对于明显康复的患者,仔细监测血小板减少和血浆渗漏仍然至关重要。

title: Extinction pathways in dengue-Zika multi-pathogen systems with antibody-dependent enhancement
abstract: Introduction Antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) creates complex multi-pathogen dynamics that fundamentally alter extinction probabilities in co-circulating dengue and Zika viruses. Methods We develop a stochastic framework for five co-circulating pathogens (dengue serotypes 1 -4 and Zika) with asymmetric ADE. Using WKB large-deviation theory, we compute extinction actions and most-probable pathways via Minimum Action, Nudged Elastic Band, and adaptive SVD methods. WKB actions are validated against Monte Carlo simulations (Pearson r = 0.98, max relative error 0.3%). Results The model predicts that DENV4 acts as a keystone pathogen: its elimination triggers a cascade (DENV4 → DENV2 → Zika) that is exponentially more probable than direct multi-pathogen extinction. The parameter space separates into three extinction regimes –sequential, pairwise, and total collapse –with hysteresis near η≈2.8 Sensitivity analysis shows keystone identity is stable under ±20% ADE matrix perturbations. In a symmetric n-pathogen limit on the symmetric invariant manifold, single-serotype extinction action decreases as 1/n while global elimination action grows as n ·S sym . Discussion Within this symmetric idealization, this provides a possible mechanistic reference point for understanding how serotype diversity could simultaneously promote local vulnerability and global persistence. Whether a similar relationship holds in the fully asymmetric dengue-Zika system is an open question. Limitations include the direct-transmission approximation (quantitative error < 15%) and time-averaged ADE. All predictions are model-based and require empirical validation.
journal: Frontiers in Applied Mathematics and Statistics

title_zh: 利用 抗体依赖性增强 确定登革热-寨卡病毒多病原体系统的灭绝途径
source_body_en: Introduction Antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) creates complex multi-pathogen dynamics that fundamentally alter extinction probabilities in co-circulating dengue and Zika viruses. Methods We develop a stochastic framework for five co-circulating pathogens (dengue serotypes 1 -4 and Zika) with asymmetric ADE. Using WKB large-deviation theory, we compute extinction actions and most-probable pathways via Minimum Action, Nudged Elastic Band, and adaptive SVD methods. WKB actions are validated against Monte Carlo simulations (Pearson r = 0.98, max relative error 0.3%). Results The model predicts that DENV4 acts as a keystone pathogen: its elimination triggers a cascade (DENV4 → DENV2 → Zika) that is exponentially more probable than direct multi-pathogen extinction. The parameter space separates into three extinction regimes –sequential, pairwise, and total collapse –with hysteresis near η≈2.8 Sensitivity analysis shows keystone identity is stable under ±20% ADE matrix perturbations. In a symmetric n-pathogen limit on the symmetric invariant manifold, single-serotype extinction action decreases as 1/n while global elimination action grows as n ·S sym . Discussion Within this symmetric idealization, this provides a possible mechanistic reference point for understanding how serotype diversity could simultaneously promote local vulnerability and global persistence. Whether a similar relationship holds in the fully asymmetric dengue-Zika system is an open question. Limitations include the direct-transmission approximation (quantitative error < 15%) and time-averaged ADE. All predictions are model-based and require empirical validation.
abstract_zh: 简介 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE) 创建了复杂的多病原体动力学,从根本​​上改变了共同传播的登革热和寨卡病毒的灭绝概率。方法 我们开发了一个具有不对称 ADE 的五种共循环病原体(登革热血清型 1 -4 和寨卡病毒)的随机框架。使用 WKB 大偏差理论,我们通过最小作用、微移弹性带和自适应 SVD 方法计算灭绝作用和最可能的路径。WKB 操作根据蒙特卡罗模拟进行验证(Pearson r = 0.98,最大相对误差 0.3%)。结果 该模型预测 DENV4 是一种关键病原体:它的消除会引发级联反应(DENV4 → DENV2 → Zika),其可能性比直接多病原体灭绝的可能性高出指数级。参数空间分为三种消光状态——顺序、成对和完全崩溃——滞后接近 η≈2.8 敏感性分析显示基石身份在 ±20% ADE 矩阵扰动下是稳定的。在对称不变流形上的对称 n 病原体极限中,单血清型灭绝作用以 1/n 的形式减少,而全局消除作用以 n ·S sym 的形式增长。讨论 在这种对称理想化中,这为理解血清型多样性如何同时促进局部脆弱性和全球持久性提供了可能的机械参考点。在完全不对称的登革热-寨卡病毒系统中是否存在类似的关系是一个悬而未决的问题。局限性包括直接 传播 近似(定量误差 < 15%)和时间平均 ADE。所有预测都是基于模型的,需要经验验证。

title: Improving Prediction of Dengue Outbreaks Using Attention-based LSTM Model with Honey Badger Optimization for Hyperparameter Tuning
abstract: Climate Change Poses a Significant Challenge to the Current Dynamics of Disease Outbreaks. This Study Improves Outbreak Prediction Using an Attention-Based LSTM Model Optimized by the Honey Badger Algorithm (HBA) for Hyperparameter Tuning. Using Disease, Climate, and Geographic Data From 2015–2024 in Different Barangays in Koronadal, South Cotabato, the Model Predicts Incidence Over 1-, 3-, 6-, and 12-Month Horizons. Attention Mechanisms Enhanced Long-Term Pattern Detection, While HBA Reduces Overfitting and Boosts Accuracy. Results Show the HBA-LSTM Reduces Mean Squared Error by 43.7% Over Standard LSTM and 22.2% Over Attention Models. Similar Reductions are Seen in RMSE, MAE, and MAPE. Though Effective, Further Tuning and Alternative Architectures are Suggested for Improved Generalization.
journal: International Journal of Latest Technology in Engineering Management & Applied Science

This Study Improves Outbreak Prediction Using an Attention-Based LSTM Model Optimized by the Honey Badger Algorithm (HBA) for Hyperparameter Tuning. Using Disease, Climate, and Geographic Data From 2015–2024 in Different Barangays in Koronadal, South Cotabato, the Model Predicts Incidence Over 1-, 3-, 6-, and 12-Month Horizons. Attention Mechanisms Enhanced Long-Term Pattern Detection, While HBA Reduces Overfitting and Boosts Accuracy. Results Show the HBA-LSTM Reduces Mean Squared Error by 43.7% Over Standard LSTM and 22.2% Over Attention Models. Similar Reductions are Seen in RMSE, MAE, and MAPE. Though Effective, Further Tuning and Alternative Architectures are Suggested for Improved Generalization.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对当前疾病动态构成重大挑战 暴发。本研究使用基于注意力的 LSTM 模型改进了 暴发 预测,该模型经蜜獾算法 (HBA) 优化用于超参数调整。该模型利用 2015 年至 2024 年南哥打巴托省 Koronadal 不同描笼涯的疾病、气候和地理数据,预测 1、3、6 和 12 个月的 发病率。注意力机制增强了长期模式检测,而 HBA 减少了过度拟合并提高了准确性。结果显示,与标准 LSTM 相比,HBA-LSTM 的均方误差降低了 43.7%,与注意力模型相比,均方误差降低了 22.2%。RMSE、MAE 和 MAPE 也有类似的降低。虽然有效,但建议进一步调整和替代架构以改进泛化。

title: Envelope-dimer epitope 1 (EDE1) antibody (C10) treatment significantly reduces Zika virus replication in the male and female reproductive tracts.
abstract: No effective therapy or vaccine exists to protect against the next Zika virus (ZIKV) outbreak. ZIKV has been detected in multiple organs of infected people, including immune-privileged sites like the brain, eyes, and reproductive tract. ZIKV replication in the reproductive tract is of high concern; ZIKV can be transmitted sexually or to the developing fetus of pregnant women, resulting in severe congenital defects. Here, we show that ZIKV-infected immunocompetent mice rapidly controlled viremia with no viral rebound following T cell depletion. In contrast, mice genetically deficient in B and T cells (immunodeficient mice) supported sustained ZIKV replication in all tissues examined. Treatment of ZIKV-infected immunodeficient mice with the novel nucleoside analog 7-deaza-7-fluoro-2'-C-methyladenosine (DFMA) significantly reduced viremia and prolonged survival, validating immunodeficient mice for efficacy studies of ZIKV prevention and therapeutic approaches. Importantly, we demonstrate that treatment of ZIKV-infected animals with a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody (EDE1, C10) suppressed systemic ZIKV replication, including in the brain, eye, and male and female reproductive tracts.IMPORTANCESince 2007, Zika virus (ZIKV) infections have been documented in over 80 countries and territories, resulting in two major outbreaks thus far. ZIKV replication in the reproductive tract is of high concern as ZIKV can be transmitted sexually or to the developing fetus of pregnant women, resulting in severe congenital defects. Currently, no effective therapy or vaccine exists to protect against the next outbreak. Here, we developed a preclinical animal model for ZIKV infection that we used to evaluate the efficacy of a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody for prevention/treatment of ZIKV infection. The antibody suppressed virus replication in blood and tissues, including the reproductive tract, suggesting that passive administration of ZIKV neutralizing antibodies could be used during future ZIKV outbreaks in high-risk populations to prevent ZIKV transmission.

analysis.research_question_and_background: No effective therapy or vaccine exists to protect against the next Zika virus (ZIKV) outbreak, and ZIKV replication in the reproductive tract is of high concern due to risks of sexual transmission and severe congenital defects.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a preclinical animal model for ZIKV infection using immunocompetent mice and genetically immunodeficient mice to evaluate the efficacy of a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody.
analysis.methods: Researchers evaluated the efficacy of a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody (EDE1, C10) and the nucleoside analog 7-deaza-7-fluoro-2'-C-methyladenosine (DFMA) in ZIKV-infected mice, measuring outcomes including viremia, survival, and viral replication in tissues.
analysis.main_results: Treatment of ZIKV-infected immunodeficient mice with DFMA significantly reduced viremia and prolonged survival, while treatment with the EDE1 antibody suppressed systemic ZIKV replication in the blood, brain, eye, and male and female reproductive tracts.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as validating immunodeficient mice for efficacy studies and demonstrating that a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody can suppress ZIKV replication in immune-privileged sites.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that passive administration of ZIKV neutralizing antibodies could be used during future ZIKV outbreaks in high-risk populations to prevent ZIKV transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific design limitations, but the evidence strength is assessed as moderate because the data are derived from an abstract-only preclinical animal model.

analysis.summary_en: This study addressed the lack of effective therapies for Zika virus (ZIKV) by developing a preclinical mouse model to test therapeutic interventions. Researchers evaluated the efficacy of a dengue virus cross-neutralizing antibody (EDE1, C10) and a nucleoside analog (DFMA) in both immunocompetent and immunodeficient mice. Results showed that DFMA treatment significantly reduced viremia and prolonged survival in immunodeficient mice, while the EDE1 antibody suppressed systemic ZIKV replication, including in the brain, eyes, and reproductive tracts. These findings validate the use of immunodeficient mice for ZIKV efficacy studies and suggest that passive antibody administration could be a viable strategy to prevent transmission during future outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 目前尚无有效的疗法或 疫苗 可以预防下一个寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 暴发,并且由于 传播 的性风险和严重的先天缺陷,生殖道中的 ZIKV 复制受到高度关注。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用免疫功能正常的小鼠和遗传免疫缺陷的小鼠开发了 ZIKV 感染的临床前动物模型,以评估 登革病毒 交叉中和抗体的功效。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员评估了 登革病毒 交叉中和抗体(EDE1、C10)和核苷类似物 7-脱氮杂-7-氟-2'-C-甲基腺苷 (DFMA) 在 ZIKV 感染小鼠中的功效,测量了病毒血症、存活率和组织中病毒复制等结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 使用 DFMA 治疗 ZIKV 感染的免疫缺陷小鼠的 治疗 可显着减少病毒血症并延长生存期,而使用 EDE1 抗体的 治疗 则可抑制血液、大脑、眼睛以及男性和女性生殖道中的全身 ZIKV 复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为验证免疫缺陷小鼠的功效研究,并证明 登革病毒 交叉中和抗体可以抑制 ZIKV 在免疫特权位点的复制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,在未来的 ZIKV 暴发 高危人群中,可以使用被动施用 ZIKV 中和抗体来预防 ZIKV 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制,但证据强度被评估为中等,因为数据来自仅抽象的临床前动物模型。

title: Integrated surveillance of arboviruses in febrile patients from the Brazilian Amazon reveals complex co-circulation dynamics and hidden viral diversity
abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Arboviral infections continue to be a significant public health challenge in the Brazilian Amazon. Overlapping symptoms, limited laboratory access, and the circulation of multiple arboviruses hamper clinical diagnosis. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological, clinical, laboratory and genomic profiles of arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, and explore additional viral agents using metagenomic sequencing. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted between February 2021 and February 2023 at a tertiary reference center in Manaus, Brazil. Patients aged ≥ 5 years of age presenting with a rash and either a fever or a history of fever lasting <7 days and a negative thick blood smear for malaria were enrolled. Serum samples were tested for dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), yellow fever virus (YF), Oropouche virus (OROV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) using ELISA and RT-qPCR. Positive samples were subjected to amplicon-based genome sequencing for phylogenetic analysis. A subset of RT-qPCR negative samples was analyzed using de novo shotgun metagenomic sequencing. Results: Among the 708 enrolled participants, 243 (34.3%) had a laboratory-confirmed arboviral infection: 92 (37.9%) DENV, 64 (26.3%) CHIKV, and 4 (1.6%) ZIKV, while 83 (34.2%) laboratory profiles were compatible with coinfection, predominantly DENV+CHIKV (55/83; 66.3%). Circulation of DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III (Asian American) and II (Cosmopolitan) was identified. Metagenomic analysis of 35 samples detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate complex arbovirus co-circulation in Manaus and support integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches.
journal: Revista da Sociedade Brasileira de Medicina Tropical

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study characterized arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, from 2021 to 2023. Among 708 participants, 34.3% had laboratory-confirmed infections, with DENV accounting for 37.9% of cases and DENV+CHIKV being the most common coinfection. Genomic analysis identified the circulation of DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III and II. Metagenomic sequencing of negative samples detected other viral agents. The authors conclude that these findings reveal complex co-circulation dynamics and support the use of integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic methods to address diagnostic challenges in the region.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 虫媒病毒感染是巴西亚马逊地区的一个重大公共卫生挑战,重叠的症状和有限的实验室访问阻碍了临床 诊断。本研究旨在描述巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染的流行病学、临床、实验室和基因组特征,并利用宏基因组测序探索其他病毒因子。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。该研究招募了 708 名 5 岁或以上的参与者,这些参与者均出现皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续不到 7 天,所有参与者的疟疾厚血涂片均呈阴性。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的 登革病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和 Mayaro 病毒 (MAYV)。阳性样本接受基于扩增子的 基因组 测序进行系统发育分析,而 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集则使用从头鸟枪法宏基因组测序进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 708 名登记参与者中,243 名(34.3%)人患有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染,其中包括 92 名(37.9%)登革热病毒病例。该研究确定了 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(大都会)的循环。此外,83 个 (34.2%) 实验室资料与双重感染相符,主要是 DENV+CHIKV (55/83;66.3%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,马瑙斯存在复杂的虫媒病毒共循环,其特征是同时存在多种 DENV 基因型以及 DENV 和 CHIKV 双重感染的高频率。作者将这些结果解释为支持结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合 监测 策略必要性的证据。

title_zh: 巴西亚马逊发热患者中虫媒病毒的综合 监测 揭示了复杂的共循环动力学和隐藏的病毒多样性
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background: Arboviral infections continue to be a significant public health challenge in the Brazilian Amazon. Overlapping symptoms, limited laboratory access, and the circulation of multiple arboviruses hamper clinical diagnosis. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological, clinical, laboratory and genomic profiles of arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, and explore additional viral agents using metagenomic sequencing. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted between February 2021 and February 2023 at a tertiary reference center in Manaus, Brazil. Patients aged ≥ 5 years of age presenting with a rash and either a fever or a history of fever lasting <7 days and a negative thick blood smear for malaria were enrolled. Serum samples were tested for dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), yellow fever virus (YF), Oropouche virus (OROV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) using ELISA and RT-qPCR. Positive samples were subjected to amplicon-based genome sequencing for phylogenetic analysis. A subset of RT-qPCR negative samples was analyzed using de novo shotgun metagenomic sequencing. Results: Among the 708 enrolled participants, 243 (34.3%) had a laboratory-confirmed arboviral infection: 92 (37.9%) DENV, 64 (26.3%) CHIKV, and 4 (1.6%) ZIKV, while 83 (34.2%) laboratory profiles were compatible with coinfection, predominantly DENV+CHIKV (55/83; 66.3%). Circulation of DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III (Asian American) and II (Cosmopolitan) was identified. Metagenomic analysis of 35 samples detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate complex arbovirus co-circulation in Manaus and support integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches.
abstract_zh: 摘要背景:虫媒病毒感染仍然是巴西亚马逊地区的一个重大公共卫生挑战。重叠的症状、有限的实验室访问以及多种虫媒病毒的传播阻碍了临床 诊断。本研究旨在描述巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染的流行病学、临床、实验室和基因组特征,并利用宏基因组测序探索其他病毒因子。方法:2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。年龄≥5岁、出现皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续<7天且疟疾厚血涂片呈阴性的患者被纳入研究。使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的 登革病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和 Mayaro 病毒 (MAYV)。对阳性样本进行基于扩增子的 基因组 测序以进行系统发育分析。使用从头鸟枪宏基因组测序分析 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集。结果:在 708 名入组参与者中,243 名(34.3%)有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV,而 83 名(34.2%)实验室资料符合双重感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV(55/83;66.3%)。确定了 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(国际大都会)的循环。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1. 结论:这些发现表明马瑙斯存在复杂的虫媒病毒共循环,并支持结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的 监测 综合策略。

title: Bridging surveillance gaps in dengue: a hierarchical model integrating mixed data sources for transmission estimation and vaccine targeting
abstract: ABSTRACT Estimating dengue force of infection (FOI) is essential for understanding transmission dynamics and targeting intervention programmes, yet surveillance data in endemic settings required for estimations are often incomplete, with varying formats. We developed a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that jointly fits age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys within a single framework, incorporating external covariates to improve parameter identifiability. Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016–2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study addressed the challenge of incomplete dengue surveillance data by developing a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that integrates age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys. Applied to 128 districts in Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016–2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in force of infection and reporting rates. Consequently, this multi-source integration offers a more consistent and less biased basis for vaccine targeting than relying on reported incidence alone.

title_zh: 弥合登革热中的 监测 差距:集成混合数据源的分层模型,用于 传播 估计和 疫苗 定位
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Estimating dengue force of infection (FOI) is essential for understanding transmission dynamics and targeting intervention programmes, yet surveillance data in endemic settings required for estimations are often incomplete, with varying formats. We developed a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that jointly fits age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys within a single framework, incorporating external covariates to improve parameter identifiability. Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016–2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.
abstract_zh: 摘要 估计登革热感染力 (FOI) 对于了解 监测 动态和制定干预计划至关重要,但估计所需的流行环境中的 监测 数据通常不完整,且格式各异。我们开发了一个贝叶斯分层催化模型,该模型在单一框架内联合拟合年龄分层病例数据、汇总病例数据和 血清流行率 调查,并结合外部协变量以提高参数可识别性。综合验证表明,即使大多数地区仅提供汇总数据,仅协变量也能恢复准确的 FOI 点估计,但这样做的不确定性校准不佳;有必要通过一次 血清流行率 调查来锚定模型,以使可信的区间覆盖范围接近名义值。该模型应用于印度尼西亚爪哇岛和巴厘岛的 128 个地区(2016-2024 年),揭示了 FOI 和报告率的显着空间异质性。爪哇的许多地区超出了世界卫生组织建议的 疫苗 引入阈值,但在使用报告的 发病率 作为优先标准时被归类为低优先级,特别是在 监测 较弱的地区。基于模型的 血清流行率 估计,集成了多个数据源,为识别 疫苗 引入的高优先级地区提供了更一致的基础,并且比报告的 发病率 更不易受到 监测 偏差的影响。

title: Hubungan Jumlah Trombosit Dengan Nilai Hematokrit Pada Infeksi Sekunder Dengue Di RSUD Pasar Rebo
abstract: Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat serius di Indonesia dengan prevalensi tinggi, khususnya pada kasus infeksi sekunder yang beresiko menimbulkan manifestasi lebih berat. Perubahan jumlah trombosit dan nilai hematokrit sering digunakan sebagai indikator laboratorium, namun hasil penelitian sebelumnya menunjukkan variasi temuan terkait hubungan keduanya. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk mengetahui hubungan antara jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada pasien infeksi sekunder dengue di RSUD Pasar Rebo. Penelitian ini menggunakan data sekunder dengan menggunakan metode kuantitatif deskriptif dan pendekatan cross sectional. Data diperoleh dari rekam medis pasien rawat inap dengan diagnosis infeksi sekunder dengue yang dikonfirmasi melalui pemeriksaan serologi IgG dan IgM positif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui teknik purposive sampling dan dianalisis menggunakan uji univariat serta bivariat dengan korelasi Spearman. Pada penelitian ini ditemukan bahwa 79,3% pasien dengan infeksi dengue sekunder mengalami trombositopenia tanpa disertai hemokonsentrasi. Kesimpulan yang didapat adalah tidak terdapat hubungan jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada infeksi sekunder dengue.

Perubahan jumlah trombosit dan nilai hematokrit sering digunakan sebagai indikator laboratorium, namun hasil penelitian sebelumnya menunjukkan variasi temuan terkait hubungan keduanya. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk mengetahui hubungan antara jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada pasien infeksi sekunder dengue di RSUD Pasar Rebo. Penelitian ini menggunakan data sekunder dengan menggunakan metode kuantitatif deskriptif dan pendekatan cross sectional. Data diperoleh dari rekam medis pasien rawat inap dengan diagnosis infeksi sekunder dengue yang dikonfirmasi melalui pemeriksaan serologi IgG dan IgM positif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui teknik purposive sampling dan dianalisis menggunakan uji univariat serta bivariat dengan korelasi Spearman. Pada penelitian ini ditemukan bahwa 79,3% pasien dengan infeksi dengue sekunder mengalami trombositopenia tanpa disertai hemokonsentrasi. Kesimpulan yang didapat adalah tidak terdapat hubungan jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada infeksi sekunder dengue.
